recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19438 unless a later final issue changes the semantics of _total or Bundle.total.
issue_request: FHIR-19438 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue asking to add a Trial Use _total search parameter/control with values none, estimate, and accurate so clients can express whether they need Bundle.total and servers may still omit or ignore it.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#a0c43a2b09, and git commit a0c43a2b09ad449f45584d2f8538a789527b674e added the _total section, table-of-contents entry, and requested value set/optional semantics to source/search.html. Later source history kept the same rule while reorganizing search result parameters and removing Trial Use tags from content that had already been in R5.
additional_context: The current source/search.html page is active in publish.ini and contains _total in both the search result parameter summary and the detailed "Total number of matching resources (_total)" section. The text still says Bundle.total is optional, servers may ignore _total, and the allowed values are none, estimate, and accurate. The linked Zulip thread explains the original implementer need and supports a parameter-level optimization hint rather than a new mandatory server behavior. No Confluence references or conflicting community records were found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. An empty audit commit was published because the current build source already represents the published issue request and preserves the intended optional/optimization-hint behavior.

related_jiras.note: A later Submitted issue about _summary=count overlap with _count=0&_total=accurate was seen in search results, but it is not final and was not decided here.
